cases.name: native touch controls, reachable settings and narrow lobby reflow
cases.scope: Ordinary browser inputs, read-only diagnostics; no actor/health/clock injection. Software render cap is a functional budget, not hardware performance evidence.

changesVerified: Mobile settings have no horizontal overflow; quality/lighting/sensitivity/preview controls fit dialog and viewport.
480x400 score panel and Controls/Pause have zero bounding-box overlap.
Real result initially has scrollTop0, focused heading, and heading/reason fully in dialog/viewport before scrolling any locator.
Native Tab reaches both result actions and scrolls them visibly into view; replay still creates fresh state.

attemptHistory.prior: reference-lab-native-check.json preserves the original3 functional passes and eight screenshots. Independent image review then found mobile settings clipping, short-height menu overlap and result focus scrolling. These were real presentation defects not covered by first assertions.
attemptHistory.current: World applied narrow settings/HUD CSS and result-heading focus fixes. All3 original flows reran with additional layout assertions; first attempt on corrected sources passed. No runtime/test edits during run, no retries.

limitations: Original local-bot lab, not competitor parity or public multiplayer.
No game clock/actor/health injection or shortened-duration fixture.
Test-only maximum10fps RAF budget;480x400 control view is functional software budget, not device-performance approval. Capped elapsed work can make game time slower than wall time.
The mobile settings test scrolls controls into view to check reachability; initial result heading/reason checks occur before any auto-scroll.
Cold-load blur remains source-reviewed without dedicated native case.
Actual public deployment acceptance remains a separate gate.

independentVisualReview.result: Mobile settings clipping, short-height menu/score overlap and initial result-heading visibility are resolved in viewed frames; Tab-scrolled actions visible. No new blocker observed.
independentVisualReview.limit: Scoped saved-frame review, not every viewport, gameplay camera or device performance.
